title: BPW-2026-0626
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0626
AFE – NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF CLEAN WATER AGENCIES (NACWA)
Bureau of Sanitation and Office of Accounting are requesting Board approval and execution of an Authority for Expenditure in the amount of $107,205 for encumbrance of funds to pay for 2026 NACWA membership renewal for the period of October 1, 2026 to September 30, 2027.
(AE27760576M, Fund 760 - Sewer Operations & Maintenance Fund, Dept. 50, Appropriation Unit 50EX82)
summary: Approves paying $107,205 to renew the city's membership in the National Association of Clean Water Agencies for October 2026 through September 2027.
